programme.title: Como en casa

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: Saving Monster Fish Living in Abandoned Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby rescues neglected fish and stray kittens from an abandoned pond, then relocates them to his home.

programme.title: I Found a Sewer INFESTED with MONSTER AQUARIUM FISH!

programme.title: I Found a Sewer Full of Rare Fish!
programme.desc: Exploring new sewers to fish, catching various exotic species, using nets and traps, and unveiling unique finds including pikes, a baby clown knife fish, and a rope fish.

programme.title: I Caught The Monster Snake Attacking My Fish...
programme.desc: Bobby investigates missing fish in his ponds, finding a large snake as the culprit and safely relocating it.

programme.title: I Found The World's Deadliest Sea Monsters...
programme.desc: Bobby rescued various dangerous sea creatures, including sharks, eels, and venomous fish, from an abandoned garage and relocated them to safer habitats.

programme.title: I Bought The World's Rarest Man Eating Fish!
programme.desc: Bobby documents their journey collecting rare man-eating catfish, including the platinum goon catfish, and shares the care and placement of their newly acquired fish.

programme.title: I Found a MONSTER Living in My Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby drains his mystery pond to uncover and relocate various fish, including a massive catfish placed by a friend, while encountering snakes and other unique aquatic creatures.

programme.title: I Found Monsters Living in an Abandoned Pool!
programme.desc: Bobby and friends explore an abandoned pool filled with fish, catching and relocating them to a lake while reacting to the unexpected finds.

programme.title: I Saved EVERY Animal From an Abandoned Pet Store!
programme.desc: Bobby and team return to an abandoned pet store to save fish living in poor conditions. Negotiating with the owner, Bobby and team buy them all and join a pond-building venture.

programme.title: I Found a Dinosaur in an Abandoned Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby goes on a mission to rescue a giant African lungfish and other rare, aggressive fish from an abandoned pond with unexpected dangers and amazing discoveries.

programme.title: I Found a Pond INFESTED with Monster Sharks!
programme.desc: Bobby catches albino Oscars, African cichlids, a clown knife fish, a Midas cichlid, and a massive freshwater shark using fish traps and nets.

programme.title: I Found an Alligator in a Hidden Tunnel...
programme.desc: Bobby and team explore a hidden tunnel full of rare fish and encounters an alligator. They catch fish, plan more explorations, and face thrilling and dangerous moments.

programme.title: I Found a Pond Infested with Sharks!
programme.desc: Bobby and team rescue rare fish from a pond, relocating koi, catfish, and sharks to new homes before the pond is destroyed.

programme.title: My Favorite Fish Died...
programme.desc: Bobby and crew discovered the tragic deaths of Sweet Cheeks, a phantom Redtail catfish, and a koi fish in various ponds at his property.

programme.title: Deadly Snake Ate These Fish!!
programme.desc: Bobby revisits an abandoned pool, discovers a snake and dead fish, and uses a new iPhone 11 Pro camera to film. They relocate the snake and confirm fish are still present.

programme.title: I Found Live Animals in a Pet Store Dumpster!
programme.desc: Bobby explores pet store dumpsters to find live animals like fish, turtles, snakes, frogs, and lobsters, rescuing them and planning to provide them with better homes.

programme.title: I Found a Sewer FILLED with Monster Alien Fish!

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Hammering Hogs with Cam Hanes
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with Cam Hanes, Max Barta, Seth Morris, and Corinne Schneider while hunting hogs in TX.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Moose Hunting in North Dakota, Catfish Regs, and A Bigfoot Family | The News Show Ep. 862 - 12 - 862
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and the MeatEater crew discuss: Randall and Phil's film from BuckFest and The Big Buck Hunter Championship; Jordan Sillar's Blood Trails, Season 2 drops; a Land Access Initiative update; Etsy bans fur; how birding improves your brain health; South Dakota becomes the first state to remove suppressors from the list of controlled weapons; Pennsylvania changes to blue and flathead catfish regulations; Bigfoot sightings in Ohio; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - The American West
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with historian and author Elliott West, Randall Williams, Brody Henderson, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Janis' Manitoba Caribou | "12 in '26" Ep. 880 - 12 - 880
programme.desc: Janis Putelis gives behind-the-scenes details and answers viewer questions about his "12 in '26" rifle and archery caribou hunts in Manitoba.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Osceola, Native American Slavery, and The Seminole Wars | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 832 - 12 - 832
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author Jamie Holmes, Randall Williams, Brody Henderson, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: Jamie's new book, The Free and the Dead: The Untold Story of the Black Seminole Chief, the Indigenous Rebel, and America's Forgotten War is out; deep archival research; the evidence base and when the notes section of the book is almost as long as the book itself; the complexity of stories about the Seminole Wars; turning what you know on its head; the environment of interior Florida; what enslavement meant to the tribes; who were the black Seminole people?; the relationship between Osceola and Abraham; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Theodore Roosevelt on Love, Ladies, and Conservation | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 841 - 12 - 841
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author of The Loves Of Theodore Roosevelt and CEO of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, Ed O'Keefe. Joined by Randall Williams, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: The ladies in Teddy's life; being a sickly child and powering through pain; hunting to study; a tremendous taxidermy collection; a family that founded so many museums; sisters as advisors and confidants; a life-altering Valentine's Day tragedy; when a thick manuscript in your front jacket pocket stops a bullet and saves your life; being the first president to embrace women's suffrage and the right to own property; one of the most beloved in American history; and more. Get The Loves Of Theodore Roosevelt here: https://www.simonandschuster.com/books/The-Loves-of-Theodore-Roosevelt/Edward-F-OKeefe/9781982145705

programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: My Son, The Chimp
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: Morticia's Favorite Charity
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: Progress And The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Toupee
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: Lurch, The Teenage Idol
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Winning Of Morticia Addams
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: My Fair Cousin Itt
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 1)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 2)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: Morticia Meets Royalty
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Gomez, The People's Choice
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Cousin Itt's Problem
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

While working towards her career goal, Amalia meets the ultimate "bad-boy", a dashing gangster named Luis, (Victor Junco). She is quickly swept off her feet and falls in love with him. Unfortunately, Luis has a jealous streak and a rather possessive personality, especially when it comes to women. He also has a prior girlfriend named Celia, (Yadira Jimenez). Celia also happens to share similar traits with Luis and is filled with jealous rage toward Amelia. So much so that she causes her rival in love to have an accident which leaves Amalia's face horribly scarred-so much so that she must now wear a mask in public. Filled with shame and fear of rejection, she decides to leave Luis without explanation or saying farewell, Her actions anger her former lover, who thinks she left him for better career opportunities. So, he decides to kill poor disfigured Amalia.

programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Re-Generation
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical…it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Last Supper
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Stream Of Consciousness

programme.title: Dark Rain

programme.title: The Camp

programme.title: Heart's Desire
